title: A friendly receipt
description:
Write `receipt(items, locale, currency)` that formats a shopping list with `Intl`. `items` is an array of `{ name, cents, qty }`.

- Each line is `"<qty> × <name>: <line total>"`, the total formatted with `Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { style: "currency", currency })` from `qty * cents / 100`.
- Then a line `"Total: <sum>"`.
- Then a line listing the item names with `Intl.ListFormat(locale, { type: "conjunction" })`, followed by `" — "` and the item count with the right plural: `"1 item"` or `"<n> items"` (use `Intl.PluralRules("en")` to choose).
- Lines are joined with `"\n"`.

For `locale = "en-US"` and `currency = "USD"`:

```
2 × Tea: $5.00
1 × Cake: $3.75
Total: $8.75
Tea and Cake — 3 items
```

An empty list gives `"Total: <zero>"` and nothing else.
hints: Make each formatter once, outside the loop: `const money = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { style: "currency", currency });` then `money.format(cents / 100)`.
Add up cents (integers) and divide by 100 only when formatting, so the total is exact. `new Intl.PluralRules("en").select(count)` returns `"one"` for 1 and `"other"` for most other numbers.
